summary: Teach/recall/playbook/learnings dry-run short-circuits now emit a writeDryRun JSON envelope ({"dry_run":true,"action":...,"would":...}) instead of returning nil silently, matching the current generator template contract. Fixes the live-dogfood json_fidelity cell for teach and playbook amend under --dry-run --json on engine 4.30.x.
reason: Live dogfood matrix on the current engine flagged teach and playbook amend json_fidelity as invalid JSON: the printed CLI returned nil on --dry-run with no stdout. Generator template already emits writeDryRun; printed CLI predates that change.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood gate PASS (76 tests, 0 failed, 58 environment-dependent skips); smoke-test 8/8 live PASS; teach/playbook amend dry-run json_fidelity both emit valid JSON.
upstream_issue: Generator template internal/generator/templates/teach.go.tmpl (and teach_playbook.go.tmpl, learnings_candidates.go.tmpl, learnings_stats.go.tmpl) already carries the writeDryRun contract; this patch aligns the printed CLI with it.
